raw_document_cases.text: Every robot has a sensor. Ara is a robot. Therefore Ara has a sensor.

reference.rationale: Universal instantiation and modus ponens under the stated interpretation.

raw_document_cases.text: Every robot has a sensor. Ara has a sensor. Therefore Ara is a robot.

reference.rationale: Ara can be a non-robot with a sensor.

raw_document_cases.text: If it rains, the pavement is wet. It does not rain. Therefore the pavement is not wet.

reference.rationale: A sprinkler can wet the pavement.

raw_document_cases.text: If it rains, the pavement is wet. The pavement is not wet. Therefore it does not rain.
Some reviewers are lawyers. Therefore all reviewers are lawyers.

reference.rationale: One lawyer reviewer and one non-lawyer reviewer satisfy the premise.

raw_document_cases.text: The witness said, "Not every vehicle was red." The report interprets this as, "No vehicle was red."

reference.rationale: A red vehicle and a blue vehicle separate the readings.

raw_document_cases.text: The politician made incompatible statements about the same event. Therefore the politician deliberately lied.

reference.rationale: Memory failure, mistake or changed knowledge can explain inconsistency; intention is additional.

raw_document_cases.text: The observed rate fell from 15 cases per 100 people to 12 cases per 100 people. Therefore the relative reduction was 50 percent.

reference.rationale: The relative reduction is (15-12)/15 = 20 percent; absolute reduction is 3 percentage points.

raw_document_cases.text: The investigation cutoff is January 1, 2025. Its only evidence is a report first published February 1, 2025. Therefore the claim was supported by eligible evidence at the cutoff.

reference.rationale: The only specified report postdates the cutoff.

raw_document_cases.text: Assume every moon is made of cheese, and assume Luna is a moon. Therefore Luna is made of cheese.

reference.rationale: Conditional validity does not verify either premise.

raw_document_cases.text: Three articles repeat the same wire report without additional reporting. Therefore three independent sources have verified the claim.

reference.rationale: Three reproductions do not supply three independent reporting origins.

raw_document_cases.text: Policy A raises total income. Therefore we ought to adopt policy A regardless of its other effects.

reference.rationale: The conclusion additionally prioritizes income over other effects.

raw_document_cases.text: The AI reports 99 percent confidence without evidence or calibration data. Therefore its answer is established as true.

reference.rationale: An unsupported confidence statement does not establish truth or calibrated accuracy.

raw_document_cases.text: Some reviewers are lawyers. Every lawyer is trained. Therefore some reviewers are trained.

reference.rationale: The existential witness is both a reviewer and trained.

raw_document_cases.text: The relevant specialist cites measurements supporting the claim. This testimony is defeasible evidence; additional contrary measurements could change the assessment.

reference.rationale: Consulting relevant expertise with evidence and defeaters is not automatically a fallacy.

raw_document_cases.text: The textbook warns that saying "all robots have sensors, Ara has a sensor, therefore Ara is a robot" commits a converse error. It does not endorse that inference.

reference.rationale: Discussion of an invalid inference is not endorsement of it.
